items.jp: カップケーキ型に、ペーパーカップを並べます。
items.kana: かっぷけーきがたに、ぺーぱーかっぷをならべます。

structure_explanation.en: The sentence begins with the destination カップケーキ型に ('in the cupcake mold'), where に marks the place where something will be placed. ペーパーカップを ('the paper liners') is the object, marked by を, and 並べる ('to arrange/line up side by side') is the main verb in the polite form 並べます. It is a typical recipe instruction, so the natural translation uses the imperative 'place/arrange'.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A frase começa com o destino カップケーキ型に ('na forma de cupcake'), em que に marca o lugar onde algo será colocado. ペーパーカップを ('as forminhas de papel') é o objeto, marcado por を, e 並べる ('dispor/enfileirar lado a lado') é o verbo principal na forma polida 並べます. É uma instrução típica de receita, então a tradução natural usa o imperativo 'coloque/disponha'.

translation_literal.en: In the cupcake shape, the paper liners (I/you) line up.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Na forma de cupcake, as forminhas de papel (eu/você) enfileira.

translation.pt-BR: Coloque as forminhas de papel na forma de cupcake.

gloss.en: to arrange, to line up (side by side)

conjugation_note.en: stem of 並べる used with ます
conjugation_note.pt-BR: radical de 並べる usado com ます

conjugation_note.en: polite suffix ます joined to 並べる
conjugation_note.pt-BR: sufixo polido ます ligado a 並べる

findings.issue: Token list contains both null subtokens カップ+ケーキ (tokens[0-1]) and a combined カップケーキ token for the same surface, so concatenated surfaces give カップケーキカップケーキ型…, breaking jp alignment (every other item concatenates exactly; ペーパーカップ gets no combined token). Remove one coverage.
findings.proposed: Remover os subtokens nulos カップ/ケーキ (tokens[0-1]) e manter apenas o token カップケーキ, que é o único com glosa.

items.jp: つながれているという思いがつのった。
items.kana: つながれているというおもいがつのった。

structure_explanation.en: The pattern 〜という〜 here links a whole clause to an abstract noun: つながれている ('to be being tied up/bound') + という + 思い ('feeling, thought') = 'the feeling of [being] bound'. This use of という presents the CONTENT of a thought. つながれている is the passive form (つながれる) in the progressive (〜ている); 思い is marked by が as the subject of つのった ('intensified', past of つのる).
structure_explanation.pt-BR: O padrão 〜という〜 (alvo: という) aqui liga uma oração inteira a um substantivo abstrato: つながれている ('estar sendo amarrado/preso') + という + 思い ('sentimento, pensamento') = 'o sentimento de [que se está] preso'. Esse uso de という apresenta o CONTEÚDO de um pensamento. つながれている é a forma passiva (つながれる) na forma progressiva (〜ている); 思い é marcado por が como sujeito de つのった ('intensificou-se', passado de つのる).

translation_literal.en: The feeling of 'being tied down' grew stronger.
translation_literal.pt-BR: O sentimento que [diz] 'estar sendo amarrado' se intensificou.

translation.pt-BR: Cresceu em mim o sentimento de estar preso.

conjugation_note.en: passive stem of つなぐ ('to tie') > つながれる ('to be tied'), here the base つながわ forming つながれ
conjugation_note.pt-BR: raiz passiva de つなぐ ('amarrar') > つながれる ('ser amarrado'), aqui a base つながわ formando つながれ

conjugation_note.en: auxiliary れる (passive), connective form れ before て
conjugation_note.pt-BR: auxiliar れる (passiva), forma conectiva れ antes de て

conjugation_note.en: いる in 〜ている (continuous state): 'to be [being] held captive'
conjugation_note.pt-BR: いる em 〜ている (estado contínuo): 'estar [sendo] preso'

role.en: verb of the という pattern (links clause to noun)
role.pt-BR: verbo do padrão という (liga oração ao substantivo)

conjugation_note.en: dictionary form of いう, within the fixed expression という
conjugation_note.pt-BR: forma de dicionário de いう, dentro da expressão fixa という

conjugation_note.en: past of つのる ('to intensify'); base つのっ + た
conjugation_note.pt-BR: passado de つのる ('intensificar-se'); base つのっ + た

findings.issue: Typo in both note locales: the passive base of つなぐ is つなが, not つながわ (a nonexistent form).
findings.current: aqui a base つながわ formando つながれ
findings.proposed: aqui a base つなが formando つながれ / here the base つなが forming つながれ

items.jp: おめでとうございます！
items.kana: おめでとうございます!

structure_explanation.en: The congratulatory greeting おめでとうございます ('congratulations', formal). Here the target pattern appears more visibly: the verb ござる ('to exist/be', humble-polite) in the form ござい followed by the polite suffix 〜ます, forming ございます. Together with おめでとう (from めでたい, 'auspicious/happy'), it produces a polite congratulation; おめでとう alone would be the informal version.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: Saudação de felicitação おめでとうございます ('parabéns', formal). Aqui o padrão-alvo aparece de forma mais visível: o verbo ござる ('haver/ser', humilde-cortês) na forma ござい seguido do sufixo polido 〜ます, formando ございます. Junto de おめでとう (de めでたい, 'auspicioso/feliz'), produz uma felicitação educada; おめでとう sozinho seria a versão informal.

conjugation_note.en: fixed adverbial form of めでたい ('auspicious')
conjugation_note.pt-BR: forma adverbial fixada de めでたい ('auspicioso')

conjugation_note.en: 連用形 form (ださ) of ござる, the base for taking 〜ます
conjugation_note.pt-BR: forma 連用形 (ださ) de ござる, base para receber 〜ます

conjugation_note.en: non-past form of ます; together with ござい forms ございます ('is/there is', polite)
conjugation_note.pt-BR: forma não-passada de ます; junto de ござい forma ございます ('é/há', cortês)

findings.issue: Note on ござい gives the 連用形 of ござる as the nonsense form '(ださ)' in both the en and pt-BR versions; the correct base that takes 〜ます is ござい.
findings.current: 連用形 form (ださ) of ござる, the base for taking 〜ます / forma 連用形 (ださ) de ござる
findings.proposed: 連用形 form (ござい) of ござる, the base for taking 〜ます / forma 連用形 (ござい) de ござる

items.jp: 彼女は天使のようにとても親切だ。
items.kana: かのじょわてんしのようにとてもしんせつだ。

structure_explanation.en: The sentence has the topic 彼女は (as for her) and ends with the noun-adjective 親切だ (is kind). The stretch 天使のように means 'l...
structure_explanation.pt-BR: A frase tem o tópico 彼女は (quanto a ela) e termina com o adjetivo nominal 親切だ (é gentil). O trecho 天使のように significa 'como um anjo': aqui 〜のように compara ela a um anjo, e funciona como advérbio modificando 'gentil'. O advérbio とても (muito) reforça a intensidade. Note que este 〜ように é o uso de COMPARAÇÃO ('como'), não o de finalidade.

translation_literal.en: As for her, like an angel, she's very kind.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Quanto a ela, igual a um anjo, é muito gentil.

translation.en: She's very kind, like an angel.
translation.pt-BR: Ela é muito gentil, como um anjo.

conjugation_note.en: に is the connective/adverbial form used with ようだ; here it forms 〜ように
conjugation_note.pt-BR: に é a forma conectiva/adverbial usada com ようだ; aqui forma 〜ように

conjugation_note.en: だ = plain affirmative form of the copula
conjugation_note.pt-BR: だ = forma afirmativa simples da cópula

findings.issue: expl_en is truncated mid-word ('means 'l...'), leaving the explanation of 〜のように incomplete; expl_pt is complete. English version must be finished to mirror expl_pt.
findings.current: ...The stretch 天使のように means 'l...
findings.proposed: The sentence has the topic 彼女は (as for her) and ends with the noun-adjective 親切だ (is kind). The stretch 天使のように means 'like an angel': here 〜のように compares her to an angel and works as an adverb modifying 'kind'. The adverb とても (very) reinforces the intensity. Note that this 〜ように is the COMPARISON use ('like'), not the purpose one.

items.jp: 家を買ったんだってね。
items.kana: いえをかったんだってね。

structure_explanation.en: The core is 家を買った ('bought a house'), with 家 as the object marked by を and the verb 買う in the past 買った. The sequence んだって comes from のだ + って: the んだ gives an explanatory tone and って reports heard information ('they said / I heard that'). The final particle ね seeks confirmation from the listener, giving the sense 'that's it, right?'.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: O núcleo é 家を買った ('comprou uma casa'), com 家 como objeto marcado por を e o verbo 買う no passado 買った. A sequência んだって vem de のだ + って: o んだ dá tom explicativo e って reporta uma informação ouvida ('disseram que / soube que'). A partícula final ね busca confirmação do interlocutor, dando o sentido 'é isso, né?'.

translation_literal.en: They say you bought a house, huh.
translation_literal.pt-BR: Casa (você) comprou, é o que dizem, né.

translation.pt-BR: Soube que você comprou uma casa, né.

conjugation_note.en: 連用形 form (て/た root) of 買う, base for the past
conjugation_note.pt-BR: forma 連用形 (radical て/た) de 買う, base para o passado

conjugation_note.en: た marks past tense: 買った ('bought')
conjugation_note.pt-BR: た marca tempo passado: 買った ('comprou')

conjugation_note.en: だ plain form of the copula, part of んだ (explanatory)
conjugation_note.pt-BR: だ forma simples da cópula, parte de んだ (explicativo)

findings.issue: 家 is the direct object of 買った (家を買った) but its role is null, unlike parallel object nouns in this batch (ラジオ 'objeto', 着物 'objeto direto').

items.jp: 彼女が自殺したというのは本当か。
items.kana: かのじょがじさつしたというのわほんとうか。

structure_explanation.en: 彼女が自殺した (she committed suicide) is quoted with と and nominalized by というのは, which turns the whole clause into the topic: 'the matter of her committing suicide'. The predicate 本当か asks whether this fact is true. The pattern 〜というのは highlights and topicalizes a content in order to then comment on it.
structure_explanation.pt-BR: 彼女が自殺した (ela se suicidou) é citado com と e nominalizado por というのは, que transforma a oração inteira em tópico: 'a coisa de que ela se suicidou'. O predicado 本当か pergunta se esse fato é verdade. O padrão 〜というのは destaca e tematiza um conteúdo para depois comentá-lo.

translation_literal.en: Is it true that she committed suicide?

translation.pt-BR: Será que é verdade que ela se suicidou?

role.en: verbal noun (root of 自殺する)
role.pt-BR: substantivo verbal (raiz de 自殺する)

conjugation_note.en: root of する; the gloss 'to print' is noise
conjugation_note.pt-BR: raiz de する; o gloss 'to print' é ruído

role.en: verb linking the quote to のは
role.pt-BR: verbo que liga a citação a のは

conjugation_note.pt-BR: forma de dicionário em 〜というのは

findings.issue: Leaked internal editorial comment in a learner-facing note: "o gloss 'to print' é ruído" / "the gloss 'to print' is noise" references a gloss that is not even present; it is QA meta-text, not content.
